negative_findings.description: Emerging Europe (emerging-europe.com), named explicitly in the coverage cell, did not surface a single Slovenia banking or payments article across two targeted searches; results returned other outlets instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Emerging Europe Slovenia banking/payments URL found in this pass. Treat as unverified rather than absent — the outlet exists and may cover Slovenia sporadically, but no evidence of a usable Slovenian banking stream was obtained.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief assumes Emerging Europe is part of the translation/aggregation layer for Slovenia; if its Slovenian banking output is thin, the layer rests more heavily on SeeNews, bne IntelliNews and STA.

negative_findings.description: No Reuters article on Slovenian banking surfaced directly in search results despite Reuters being named in the cell scope; only third-party references and aggregator restatements appeared.
negative_findings.result_summary: Reuters recorded as a candidate on general grounds only, with confidence lowered accordingly and no example URL beyond the homepage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Reuters items are usually the reference English version of an event; being unable to locate them via general search means the collection design must use a licensed feed or on-site search rather than open web discovery.

negative_findings.description: Bloomberg, SeeNews, bne IntelliNews, STA wire and the Payment Yearbooks all gate their substantive content; only headlines and ledes are openly retrievable.
negative_findings.result_summary: The English translation/aggregation layer for Slovenia is predominantly commercial. Free open-web English coverage is limited to The Slovenia Times, Total Slovenia News, issuer IR pages, SEOnet, Investegate and bsi.si/en.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A monitoring design that relies only on free sources will see event headlines but not the detail; budget for at least one regional wire subscription (SeeNews or bne) if depth is required.

negative_findings.description: The Ljubljana Stock Exchange SEOnet portal states that only the Slovene text of an announcement has legal value; the English interface is a convenience rendering.
negative_findings.result_summary: English versions of Slovenian regulated disclosures are non-authoritative by construction.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any analytic claim resting on an English disclosure must be traceable to the Slovenian original; English-only collection is structurally insufficient for the disclosures topic.

negative_findings.description: Beyond NLB, English-language IR/translated-release infrastructure for other Slovenian financial institutions (Nova KBM/OTP Slovenija, SKB, Gorenjska Banka, Sparkasse, Delavska hranilnica, Addiko Bank Slovenija, Bankart) was not individually confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only NLB was verified to maintain a full parallel English press-release and investor-news stream; the others were seen only through third-party English coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If non-NLB issuers publish only in Slovenian, the English layer for them is entirely dependent on SeeNews/bne/STA, which makes those aggregators load-bearing rather than merely convenient.

coverage_gaps.description: No verified English IR/press-release endpoints for OTP Slovenija (post-NKBM/SKB merger), Addiko Bank Slovenija, Gorenjska Banka, Sparkasse, Delavska hranilnica or the processor Bankart.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated per-issuer pass in sl and en on each institution's site (terms: 'sporočila za javnost', 'za medije', 'letno poročilo', 'vlagatelji'), and record whether an English mirror exists and how complete it is relative to the Slovenian version.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is by definition the English layer, but the pass confirmed that English renderings are systematically partial (SEOnet legal caveat; SL-only investor news pages on nlbgroup.com/si-sl).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the monitor as SL-primary with EN as a discovery/cross-check channel: crawl SL and EN versions of the same issuer paths and diff them to produce an explicit 'untranslated disclosures' queue.

coverage_gaps.description: Regional aggregators were sampled but their Slovenia-specific banking cadence (items per month, lag versus the SL original) was not measured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a two-week baseline capture across SeeNews Slovenia, bne IntelliNews, STA English and The Slovenia Times, logging publication timestamps against the corresponding SEOnet/issuer release times to quantify translation lag.

coverage_gaps.description: Rating agencies were only partly covered: S&P and Fitch actions on Slovenian banks were seen through press restatements, and Moody's was not covered at all in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Register free accounts on Fitch, S&P Global Ratings and Moody's, identify the Slovenian bank issuer pages, and add them as direct English primary sources for the ratings topic.

coverage_gaps.description: EU-level supervisory and statistical publishers that render Slovenian bank data in English (ECB SSM, EBA transparency exercise/risk dashboard, ECB payments statistics) were not enumerated in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ECB/SSM press and EBA data hubs as a separate sub-cell; they are the most reliable English quantitative layer for Slovenian banks and require no translation.

brief: The English-language layer over Slovenian banking and payments is thin, commercial and concentrated: STA's English service is the upstream translator, and SeeNews plus bne IntelliNews are the two regional wires that actually carry Slovenian bank results, M&A and ratings for an investor audience — all three are subscription-gated, with free restatement available mainly via The Slovenia Times and Total Slovenia News. Genuine English primary material does exist and should be preferred: NLB's int-en investor-relations and press-release streams, its LSE/RNS filings mirrored free on Investegate, the LJSE SEOnet English interface, and Banka Slovenije's fully translated Financial Stability Reports and payments pages. For payments specifically the EU trade layer (Finextra, The Paypers, FinTech Futures, European Payments Council) carries Bankart/Flik infrastructure news that domestic general press covers only in Slovenian. The decisive constraint found in this pass is that SEOnet states only the Slovene text has legal value and NLB's Slovenian investor-news pages have no guaranteed English twin, so the English layer must be treated as a discovery and cross-check channel over a Slovenian-primary collection design, never as a substitute for it.
